map.tours.map-manager.title: Map Manager
map.tours.map-manager.description: Introduction to the purpose of the map manager. As well as how it relates to Stargazer
map.tours.map-manager.1.title: Map Manager
map.tours.map-manager.1.content:
Your link to Stargazer

Here you can sync your Stargazer maps with Foundry. This requires connecting your Stargazer account within the module settings.

What is Stargazer?

Stargazer is a separate site where you can create custom RPG maps. It is free to signup and use.
map.tours.generate-scene.title: Scene Generation
map.tours.generate-scene.description: Introduction to the scene generation window. Explaining the many configurations it has.
map.tours.generate-scene.1.title: Scene Generation
map.tours.generate-scene.1.content:
Native Foundry

This takes your Stargazer map and creates a Foundry scene from it.

Configuration

You can set the image size using the width and height. You can set how far zoomed in and at what location the view is placed at.

It's recommended to not add notes or change the background image to the scene after generation. Since your next Scene Generation will overwrite these!
